rows.mappingNote: New 来日/らいにち article; compatible coming/visit/arrival-in-Japan identity.
rows.sourceNote: Separate 来日/らいじつ future-day family is not an alternative reading of these uses. Destination is lexicalized; no absolute nationality rule inferred.

rows.mappingNote: New 落第/らくだい article; examination/advancement failure and figurative failure to meet a standard.
rows.sourceNote: Raw dropping-out gloss is qualified rather than equated with 退学/中退. 留年 is repeating a school year; 合格 is a result contrast.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary rush-hour article; alternate ラッシュ・アワー recognized.
rows.sourceNote: The period differs from commuting or congestion themselves; no extra level assignments.

source.waller_definition: column of text (e.g. as in a newspaper)

rows.mappingNote: New 欄/らん article; printed section/column and form/web field or blank.
rows.sourceNote: Original handrail sense is acknowledged outside practical examples. Separate おばしま entry is not transferred. Ordinary printing senses of 列/段 remain relevant despite narrower visible labels.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary article anchored to supplied lunch/lunch-set family; source launch recognized as a separate boat identity.
rows.sourceNote: The mixed raw gloss remains unchanged. Meal family1140100 and boat2854169 are distinguished; no product-launch sense is borrowed from ローンチ or ranch identity2854174, and no separate N2 assignment is asserted.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary article explicitly teaches running and abbreviated ランニングシャツ clothing.
rows.sourceNote: Activity uses ランニングをする; garment is tank top/vest/singlet. No claim that every running shirt is this noun or that every additional public-dictionary sense is N2.

rows.mappingNote: New 乱暴/らんぼう article; violence/rowdiness and rough/reckless handling/language.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/na-adjective and intransitive suru behavior qualified by sense. Sexual-assault sense3 explicitly outside selected practical examples; no invented rarity label. Search-only 亂暴 is not primary metadata.

rows.mappingNote: New 理科/りか article; school science plus broader scientific/related fields and corresponding faculties.
rows.sourceNote: Does not deny broader ordinary senses to manufacture a rigid distinction from 科学. No inferred kanji-based vocabulary level.

rows.mappingNote: New 利害/りがい article; advantages/disadvantages and parties' interests at stake.
rows.sourceNote: Opposite-pair composition distinguished from curiosity/attention and from either favorable or unfavorable half alone. Final exact 長短 family/body inspected separately.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary rhythm article; music and recurring daily-life pattern.
rows.sourceNote: Relevant ordinary 調子 rhythm sense guarded; tempo distinguished from beat pattern. No automatic transfer of different 節 readings.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary litre/liter article; French loan and 立 recognition.
rows.sourceNote: kanji metadata remains empty. Public unit definition supports cubic decimetre and1000mL; volume is not mass, and character lookup is not a new spelling-level assignment.

rows.mappingNote: New kana-primary ribbon article; decorative strip plus printing/gymnastics scope.
rows.sourceNote: Public dictionary supports ink-ribbon use. Actual テープ/帯 strip senses considered without making every cord, ornament or necktie a synonym.

rows.mappingNote: New 略す/りゃくす article; abbreviation/shortening and omission.
rows.sourceNote: Modern transitive godanす forms explicitly taught. On-derived kango classification does not imply suru conjugation; separate 略する2255170 distinguished. Sense3 taking/capture/stealing outside selected examples.

rows.mappingNote: New 流域/りゅういき article; river basin/catchment and along-river area.
rows.sourceNote: Hydrological boundary distinguished from basin-shaped landform and valley, without denying contextual basin/valley translations. Broad area comparisons are pairwise, not an all-geography clique.

rows.mappingNote: New 寮/りょう residential-accommodation article; unrelated 量 homophone not reused.
rows.sourceNote: Student/employee shared housing selected. Archaic bureau, tea-room and villa senses acknowledged outside scope. 宿 includes dwelling as well as travel accommodation; not every hotel/apartment is a dormitory.

rows.mappingNote: New 両側/りょうがわ article; compatible alternative りょうそく recognized.
rows.sourceNote: On-first mixed リョウ+がわ uses repository kango type and explains jūbakoyomi; ガワ is not invented as on reading. Separate primary 側/そば proximity identity is not conflated.

rows.mappingNote: New 漁師/りょうし fisherman article; リョウ+シ checked against components.
rows.sourceNote: Distinct hunter 猟師 homophone and person/activity/product scopes explained; no ギョ reading transferred from 漁業.

rows.mappingNote: New 領事/りょうじ consul article; person separated from 領事館 institution.
rows.sourceNote: Public role and 領 management sense support practical explanation, not a territory-ownership etymology or detailed international-law rule.

rows.mappingNote: New 領収/りょうしゅう article anchored to receiving money; transitive suru action.
rows.sourceNote: Raw receipt/voucher gloss retained but disambiguated. 領収書/領収証/レシート name documents; 受け取り has both act and paper senses. General receiving labels assessed with actual constructions, not POS exemptions.

rows.mappingNote: New 臨時/りんじ article; temporary/provisional and special/extra arrangements.
rows.sourceNote: Explicit の attachment and compounds; no na-adjective pattern. Nonregular arrangement is distinguished from unnecessary surplus without denying actual extra/special/temporary overlaps.
